White paper version | Same task and finish | Point, speak, draw, write or use a scribe.
P5 | Supported | Team ____ | My code ____
Try, review and plan the visit. Follow the adult’s agreed task. No eating or food handling is needed to take part.
1 Find your part with an adult. At the GROW station, use the agreed steps. At the panel, look at a safe sample, pack or label.
2 You can choose not to taste. Say or point to one thing you checked. An adult can keep your exact words.
3 Add your real reply to Keep, Change or Not sure. Check the tally with help.
My part was ____________________.I checked ____________________.My reply: Keep / Change / Not sure / Pass.I tasted / I did not taste. My reason ____________________.
Panel tally: Keep ____ + Change ____ + Not sure ____ = ____ replies.Tasted ____; Not tasted ____. Count only real replies. Keep a pass or no reply out of the total.
The adult checks food before any taste. Never taste a hot or unchecked sample. A pack or label check can be useful. Mark it not tasted.
Finish
Keep one own action or clear comment and a checked tally. Say what could change or what still needs a check. Show it, say it or share quietly. You may pass.

resources.title: Station support one
paragraphs_in_document_order: Station support one
Thursday 19 November 2026 | 12:50–14:10 | Year A
Set up

Thursday 19 November 2026. P5: support feedback panel A. Put out the feedback cards, approved samples or non-food models, labels and pencils. Follow the teacher's common brief. P6: support mixed team A with the enquiry and travel cards. Offer the usual aid and white, blue or pink paper with the same finish.
What to look for

Keep feedback specific: what did the pupil actually see or check? Tasting is optional. Appearance, a pack or a label gives a valid no-taste route. Mark not tasted; never turn a visual view into a taste claim. Use Keep, Change or Not sure, with a reason. A pupil may pass or answer privately.
Support and record

Point; ask a short question; rephrase; offer a frame or choice; model the first step only, then return the task. No cold calling. Record an anonymous code, actual action or exact scribed line, evidence reference and actual help. Keep tasting basis separate from the feedback tally.
Reset and P6 finish

At the reset, follow the stop cue and secure samples as the adult directs. P6 starts with the teacher's 13:35 to 13:40 model. Help team A make a roleplay enquiry or unsent draft, then check a travel, kit and risk plan for the open-air museum. Keep unknowns for adult review. Finish: a checked feedback reason, then one enquiry and planning line. No external contact.

resources.title: Station support two
paragraphs_in_document_order: Station support two
Thursday 19 November 2026 | 12:50–14:10 | Year A
Set up

Thursday 19 November 2026. P5: support feedback panel B with the same shared task. Have feedback cards, approved labels or models and pencils ready. P6: support mixed team B. The teacher introduces and leads every task. Paper colour is a choice, not a level.
What to look for

Help pupils separate an observed feature from a guess. Tasting is optional and adult-controlled. A pupil can use appearance, a pack or a label and mark not tasted. Check the response tally without assuming ten responses or ten tasters. Keep a pass separate from Not sure.
Support and record

Point; ask a short question; rephrase; offer a frame or choice; model one first step, then return the task. No cold calling. Allow pointing, exact scribing, the usual aid or a private response. Record anonymous code, actual action, evidence reference and actual help. Keep any uncertain claim open for adult review.
Reset and P6 finish

Follow the stop and reset cue. At 13:35 to 13:40, hear the teacher's enquiry model with everyone. Help team B choose a call roleplay or unsent email draft and make the travel, kit and risk plan. Preserve at least one home pupil during short appointments. Finish: one evidence-based feedback reason, then an enquiry and a clear adult check. No booking or external contact is performed.

P5 practical boundary

Cold finishing is the default. Use a hot kitchen only if the owner confirms an approved one-room layout, safe supervision and a suitable existing method. Do not force cooking or cooling into twenty-five minutes. Use approved cold work or a non-food equivalent if needed. Follow existing food checks; invent no recipe, temperature or cooking time.

Never leave hot work unattended.
Record and finish

Keep actual choices, help and gaps through the accepted route. No full L7a, L7b or award completion is inferred. Point, question, rephrase, scaffold, then model only the first step. No cold calling. Finish: a focused record or pending check, then return to the travel task.

Look at an approved sample, appearance, a pack or a label. You do not have to taste or handle food. Only taste if the adult has completed the checks and you choose to. If you do not taste, mark NOT TASTED and say what you looked at. A photo or non-food model can support the same feedback task.
Our feedback steps
